newsitem.title: MEXICO: Aeroperu exec said only Mexican hostage in Lima.
newsitem.headline: Aeroperu exec said only Mexican hostage in Lima.

text.p: Armando Vicente Celis, manager of operations for the Aeroperu airline, is the only Mexican among the more than 400 hostages being held by leftist guerrillas at the Japanese embassy residence in Lima, Mexican media reports said Thursday.
The Mexican ambassador to Peru, Federido Urruchua, told the official Mexican news agency Notimex that Celis was among those taken hostage by Tupac Amaru rebels during a party Tuesday night.
Aeroperu is owned by Cintra SA de CV, the Mexican company that also owns Aeromexico.
Veronica Flores, the wife of the hostage, told the local TV Azteca network that Aeroperu officials called her to inform her of the bad news. She said she fears for his life.
Urruchua, the Mexican ambassador, said he was at the party but left 15 minutes before the guerrillas arrived.
